layers.authority: CONANP (Comision Nacional de Areas Naturales Protegidas), Parque Nacional Revillagigedo
layers.process: Entry fee of MXN 3760 per person per day (about A$284.20; A$1 = about MXN 13.23 (RBA 30 October 2026, A$1 = USD 0.7040; Banco de Mexico FIX, USD 1 = MXN 18.7962)). Exempt: older adults, pensioners and retirees, people with disability and children under 12 (credential shown on entry). 75% off for students and teachers with a credential; 50% off for Mexican nationals and foreign residents who show an official document. Open not a day-visit park: it is reached by sea, about 471 km from Cabo San Lucas (about 36 hours) or 694 km from Manzanillo (about 60 hours). Tourists dive from boats run by tourism providers; the page lists no separate permit, so check with the park.

zone-requirements.notes: Federal park fees and rules as published on CONANP's Descubre ANP page, which says amounts follow the Ley Federal de Derechos and can change. Other parks in this state aren't checked.

laws.rule: Revillagigedo National Park: CONANP's visitor rules say practise low-impact diving, follow instructions from the Navy (SEMAR) and CONANP, and comply with the rules in the park's management programme.
